blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Let \(f(x) = \sin^{-1}x\). State the domain and range of \(f(x)\) and \(f^{-1}(x)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh inverse sine function aur us ke inverse ka domain aur range likhne ka sawal hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = \sin^{-1}x\).
Find kya karna hai? f aur inverse dono ka domain aur range.
Rule: \(\sin^{-1}x\) sine ka inverse hai, magar sirf \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) par, jahan sine one-to-one hai.
Plan: f ka domain aur range likhein, phir inverse ke liye swap karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \sin^{-1}x\).
Maloom karna: \(f\) aur \(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range.
Tareeqa: poore number line par \(\sin x\) one-to-one nahin (har value baar baar aati hai), is liye usay \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) par mehdood (restrict) kar ke inverse banaya jata hai. Isi liye \(f^{-1}(x) = \sin x\) sirf isi interval par hai.

\(f\) ka domain
\[D_{f} = [-1, 1]\]
Kyun: \(\sin^{-1}x\) poochta hai 'woh angle kaunsa hai jis ka sine \(x\) hai?'. Kisi bhi angle ka sine \(-1\) se 1 ke beech hi hota hai, is liye \(x\) bhi isi ke beech ho sakta hai. Masalan \(\sin^{-1}2\) ka koi jawab nahin.

\(f\) ki range
\[R_{f} = \left[-\tfrac{\pi}{2}, \tfrac{\pi}{2}\right]\]
Kyun: jawab wala angle hamesha principal interval \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) se liya jata hai, taa ke har \(x\) ka sirf ek jawab ho.

\(f^{-1}(x) = \sin x\) ka domain aur range
\[D_{f^{-1}} = R_{f} = \left[-\tfrac{\pi}{2}, \tfrac{\pi}{2}\right]\]
\[R_{f^{-1}} = D_{f} = [-1, 1]\]
Kyun: inverse domain aur range ki jagah badal deta hai.
Dhyan dein: yahan \(\sin x\) ka domain poori real line nahin, sirf \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) hai.

Tasdeeq:
\(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) par \(\sin x\) \(\sin(-\frac{\pi}{2}) = -1\) se \(\sin\frac{\pi}{2} = 1\) tak barhta hai, is liye us ki range \([-1, 1]\) hai. Bilkul wahi jo upar aaya.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Let \(f(x) = \sin^{-1}x\). Sketch the graph of \(f(x)\) and show that it is one-to-one using the horizontal line test.
blocks.explanation:
Pehle graph banana hai, phir horizontal line test se one-to-one dikhana hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = \sin^{-1}x\), \(-1 \le x \le 1\).
Find kya karna hai? Graph ka sketch aur yeh saboot ke koi horizontal line use ek se zyada dafa nahin kaatti.
Plan: jaane pehchane angles se table, smooth curve, phir general line y = c.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \sin^{-1}x\), \(x \in [-1, 1]\).
Karna: f ka sketch aur horizontal line test se one-to-one saabit karna.
Tareeqa: table ke liye woh angles lein jin ka sine humein zabani yaad hai (\(\frac{\pi}{6}\), \(\frac{\pi}{2}\)); test ke liye \(f(x) = c\) solve karein.

Values ki table
\[\sin^{-1}(-1) = -\tfrac{\pi}{2} \approx -1.57\]
\[\sin^{-1}\left(-\tfrac{1}{2}\right) = -\tfrac{\pi}{6} \approx -0.52\]
\[\sin^{-1}0 = 0\]
\[\sin^{-1}\tfrac{1}{2} = \tfrac{\pi}{6} \approx 0.52\]
\[\sin^{-1}1 = \tfrac{\pi}{2} \approx 1.57\]
Kyun: \(\sin\frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\) aur \(\sin\frac{\pi}{2} = 1\) yaad hain. Sine odd function hai (\(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\)), is liye negative values bas sign badal kar mil jati hain.

Sketch
Points ko smooth curve se jorein: \(\left(-1, -\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) se \(\left(1, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) tak. Graph ke dono siron par band (bhare hue) dots hain aur yeh shuru se aakhir tak oopar chadhta hai.
Kyun: domain band interval \([-1, 1]\) hai, is liye graph dono taraf ruk jata hai; teer (arrow) nahin lagta.
Dhyan dein: graph ke siron par curve khari (steep) ho jati hai, aur beech mein origin ke paas line y = x ke qareeb hoti hai.

\(y = c\) se horizontal line test
\[\sin^{-1}x = c,\quad -\tfrac{\pi}{2} \le c \le \tfrac{\pi}{2}\]
\[x = \sin c\]
Kyun: aisi har \(c\) ke liye \(x = \sin c\) ki bilkul ek value hai. Agar \(c\) is interval se bahar ho (masalan \(c = 2\)) to line graph ko chhooti hi nahin. Yani koi line ek se zyada dafa nahin milti, aur yahi one-to-one ki shart hai ('zyada se zyada ek dafa').

Tasdeeq:
Line \(y = 0.5\) curve ko sirf \(x = \sin 0.5 \approx 0.48\) ke paas milti hai, \(y = 1.2\) sirf \(x \approx 0.93\) par, aur \(y = -1\) sirf \(x \approx -0.84\) par. Figure mein bhi har line ek hi dafa kaat rahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(y = \sin^{-1}x\) ka graph \(\left(-1, -\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) se \(\left(1, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) tak chadhta hua curve hai; har horizontal line use zyada se zyada ek dafa milti hai, is liye \(f\) one-to-one hai.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of y = inverse sine of x from (-1, -pi/2) through (-0.5, -pi/6), (0, 0) and (0.5, pi/6) to (1, pi/2); the dashed horizontal lines y = -1, y = 0.5 and y = 1.2 each cut the curve once.
answer_figure.caption: y = sin⁻¹x on [−1, 1]: each horizontal line meets it at most once

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein Question 2 ke part (ii) ka koi alag jawab nahin. \(f(x) = \sin^{-1}x\) ka graph aur horizontal line test dono (iii) ke neeche ek saath diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Let \(f(x) = \sin^{-1}x\). Draw the graph of \(f^{-1}(x)\) and verify that it is the reflection of \(f(x)\) in the line \(y = x\).
blocks.explanation:
Ab inverse ka graph banana hai aur f se muqabla karna hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = \sin^{-1}x\), is liye \(f^{-1}(x) = \sin x\), \(-\frac{\pi}{2} \le x \le \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Find kya karna hai? Inverse ka graph aur yeh tasdeeq ke yeh f ka y = x mein aks hai.
Plan: part (ii) ke points ke coordinates ulat dein, un se sin x ka curve banayein, phir aaine wali shart check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \sin^{-1}x\), \(f^{-1}(x) = \sin x\), \(x \in \left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\).
Tasdeeq karna: \(f^{-1}\) ka graph \(f\) ke graph ka \(y = x\) mein reflection hai.
Tareeqa: \(f\) par point \((a, b)\) ho to \(f^{-1}\) par \((b, a)\) hota hai, aur \((b, a)\) asal mein \((a, b)\) ka \(y = x\) mein aks hai. Is liye points ulat kar graph banana hi reflection hai.

Inverse ke points
\[\left(-1, -\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right) \to \left(-\tfrac{\pi}{2}, -1\right)\]
\[\left(-\tfrac{1}{2}, -\tfrac{\pi}{6}\right) \to \left(-\tfrac{\pi}{6}, -\tfrac{1}{2}\right)\]
\[(0, 0) \to (0, 0)\]
\[\left(\tfrac{1}{2}, \tfrac{\pi}{6}\right) \to \left(\tfrac{\pi}{6}, \tfrac{1}{2}\right)\]
\[\left(1, \tfrac{\pi}{2}\right) \to \left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}, 1\right)\]
Kyun: yeh bilkul \(y = \sin x\) ke points hain, masalan \(\sin\frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\). Origin \(y = x\) par hai, is liye woh apna hi aks hai.

Aaine wali shart
\[\text{slope} = \dfrac{a - b}{b - a} = -1\]
Har jore ko milane wali line \(y = x\) par perpendicular hai aur us ka midpoint \(\left(\frac{a+b}{2}, \frac{a+b}{2}\right)\) \(y = x\) par hai.
Kyun: is ka matlab \(y = x\) har jore ka perpendicular bisector (beech se aur 90 degree par kaatne wali line) hai. Aaine ka kaam yahi hai: cheez aur us ka aks aaine se barabar faasle par, seedhi line mein.

Shakalon ka muqabla
Dono curves origin se guzarte hain. \(x > 0\) ke liye \(\sin^{-1}x\) line \(y = x\) se oopar hai aur \(\sin x\) usi faasle par neeche; \(x < 0\) ke liye ulta.
Kyun: y = x mein reflection line ki dono taraf ko badal deta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\sin x\) ka yeh hissa sirf \(-\frac{\pi}{2}\) se \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) tak banana hai, poori sine wave nahin.

Tasdeeq:
Sire: \(f\) \(\left(1, \frac{\pi}{2}\right) \approx (1, 1.57)\) par khatam hota hai aur \(f^{-1}\) \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, 1\right) \approx (1.57, 1)\) par. Coordinates ulte hue, bilkul jaisa hona chahiye.
blocks.final_answer: \(f^{-1}(x) = \sin x\), \(-\frac{\pi}{2} \le x \le \frac{\pi}{2}\): sine ka curve \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, -1\right)\) se \((0, 0)\) ke raste \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, 1\right)\) tak. Yeh \(y = \sin^{-1}x\) ka line \(y = x\) mein reflection hai.

answer_figure.alt: The curves y = inverse sine of x (from (-1, -pi/2) to (1, pi/2)) and y = sin x for x from -pi/2 to pi/2 (from (-pi/2, -1) to (pi/2, 1)) with the line y = x; dashed segments join (1, pi/2) to (pi/2, 1) and (-1, -pi/2) to (-pi/2, -1).
answer_figure.caption: y = sin⁻¹x and y = sin x, −π/2 ≤ x ≤ π/2, are mirror images in y = x
